Alex has worked at Northwind Labs since February 2023 and became a senior data engineer in March
2025. Alex leads the Atlas Migration, which moves nightly batch pipelines to a managed warehouse
using Airflow. Go-live is planned for 15 November 2026, and Alex thinks that date is unrealistic.
